svg.text: NOT FOR RELEASE: 2 CHECK ERRORS, SEE CHECKS REPORT
1. FABRICATE, INSPECT AND TEST PER IPC/WHMA-A-620, CLASS 2.
2. ALL DIMENSIONS IN MM. LENGTHS ARE MEASURED FROM CONNECTOR REAR FACE TO BREAKOUT CENTRE OR TO THE NEXT CONNECTOR REAR FACE.
3. LENGTH TOLERANCES UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED: ≤300: ±5, ≤1000: ±10, over: ±1%. SEGMENT DIMENSIONS GOVERN; OVERALL DIMENSIONS ARE REFERENCE.
4. DRAWING NOT TO SCALE. WIRE CUT LENGTHS PER WIRE LIST; CONNECTIONS PER CONNECTOR TABLES AND WIRING DIAGRAM.
6. TWISTED WIRE CUT LENGTHS INCLUDE 3% TAKE-UP OVER THE TWISTED RUN.
7. LABELS READ TOWARD THE CONNECTOR; POSITION DIMENSIONED FROM DATUM TO LABEL CENTRE.
8. CONTINUITY-TEST 100% AGAINST THE WIRE LIST; NO SHORTS BETWEEN NETS.
9. STRIP 3 mm FOR CRIMP CONTACTS, 8 mm FOR RING LUG.
